decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is cheap to keep as a delivery option, and its value is not yet clearly disproven, but its overlap with umbrella line D keeps consolidation a real possibility.
The seventy-two-hour service is operationally costly and could be folded into the express line, but results so far do not show it lacks value, so the option stays open for another period.
The multi-model express line with its own page is the strategic umbrella for fast delivery and justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The digital ordering and services platform has low marginal cost, high upside, and fits the firm's service-oriented direction with trade partners.

The fire and smoke protection door meets steady compliance-driven demand within the certified core offer, though dropping the related fire door C shows the firm does prune fire-protection items that underperform.
